flowchart TB
    subgraph IN0[Input]
        U([User query])
    end

    subgraph PIPE[RAG pipeline]
        QE[Query enhance]
        HR[Hybrid retrieve]
        RF[RRF k=60]
        CR[Corrective RAG]
        GG{Ground OK?}
        CC[Context trim]
        LM[LLM gen]
        FC[NLI check]
        SC[5-sig + Platt]
    end

    subgraph OUT0[Output]
        R([Answer + sources + conf])
    end

    U --> QE --> HR --> RF --> CR --> GG
    GG -->|yes| CC --> LM --> FC --> SC --> R
    GG -->|retry| HR

    style U fill:#4A90D9,color:#fff,stroke:#2c3e50
    style R fill:#27AE60,color:#fff,stroke:#2c3e50
    style GG fill:#F39C12,color:#fff,stroke:#2c3e50
    style LM fill:#8E44AD,color:#fff,stroke:#2c3e50
    style HR fill:#2980B9,color:#fff,stroke:#2c3e50
    style SC fill:#16A085,color:#fff,stroke:#2c3e50
